source.dataset: European Hydrogen Incidents and Accidents Database HIAD 2.2
source.public_hrs_selection: FACILITY.Application exactly equals Hydrogen refuelling station

cohort.selection: all public HRS cases in the existing reproducible inventory
cohort.split: retrospective development cohort; no holdout claim

collection.execution_mode: in-process FastAPI TestClient; no persistent server

analysis.primary_machine_proxy: mean of expected coarse action-category recall and five-stage response coverage
analysis.comparison: paired SAGA-linked minus deterministic alarm-only baseline

outcome_history.reason: The category taxonomy and playbook coverage were existing development artifacts before this response benchmark was designed.

prohibited_after_response_access: changing keyword families to improve observed scores
excluding low-scoring cases or failed provider calls
describing the result as expert validation, safety evidence, field effectiveness, or a prospective holdout
claim_boundary: Retrospective development-only machine proxy over 34 public HIAD HRS cases. Coarse category agreement and response-stage coverage do not establish action correctness, operator usability, field safety, causal validity, or SAGA effectiveness. The locked independent expert study remains required.
